description: Bind the animation targets themselves to task state: an invisible parent does not deactivate a child style's animation.
find:
<Grid Width="10" Height="10"
                                                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsRunning}">
                                                                <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8"
                                                                         Fill="{DynamicResource SukiSuccessColor}"
                                                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         Classes="PulseAnimation" />
                                                                <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8"
                                                                         Stroke="{DynamicResource SukiSuccessColor}"
                                                                         StrokeThickness="1"
                                                                         Opacity="0.45"
                                                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         Classes="PulseAnimation" />
                                                            </Grid>
replace:
<Grid Width="10" Height="10"
                                                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsRunning}">
                                                                <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8"
                                                                         Fill="{DynamicResource SukiSuccessColor}"
                                                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                         IsVisible="{Binding IsRunning}"
                                                                         Classes="PulseAnimation" />
                                                                <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8"
                                                                         Stroke="{DynamicResource SukiSuccessColor}"
                                                                         StrokeThickness="1"
                                                                         Opacity="0.45"
                                                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
